study: COT actor predictive power — overlap/FDR validated

validation_contract.caution: Fisher-z p-values for Spearman are approximate and the metric family is dependent across horizons/predictors; FDR labels are evidence screens, not causal proof
validation_contract.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR on approximate two-sided Fisher-z p-values from non-overlapping Spearman correlations across all 2,655 metrics
validation_contract.oos_gain: pre-2022 OLS coefficients frozen and evaluated in 2022+; OOS R2 and RMSE improvement must both be positive
validation_contract.overlap_confirmation: discovery, holdout and non-overlapping Spearman signs must agree; |holdout rho| and |independent rho| >= 0.10; holdout N>=30 and independent N>=20
